headline: Same accuracy as Haiku on 1,000 product classifications, in 0.9 seconds instead of 82.
text:
1/ General intelligence is a hammer.  It can do almost anything, but it isn't built for anything in particular.

So we gave Jev a whirl in Omni.  Same accuracy as Haiku on 1,000 product classifications, in 0.9 seconds instead of 82.
